statement: The first line holds n; the second holds n integers viewed as a complete binary tree in an array: the children of index i sit at 2i+1 and 2i+2. Print yes when the array satisfies the min-heap promise - every parent is at most each existing child - and no otherwise. One loop over the internal nodes (indices 0 to n/2 - 1) comparing each with its one or two children settles it.

example.why: 10 is under its children 20 and 30; 20 is under its children 21 and 23; leaves prove nothing.

hint: Guard the child indices against n before comparing - the last internal node may have one child only.
mistake: Expecting the array to be sorted; the promise runs along parent-child edges only, and siblings may be in any order.
